prompt:
You are helping a software engineering team write their weekly internal communications. The team is called 'Platform Infrastructure' and they work on backend systems. Write a 3P update (Progress, Plans, Problems format) for the week of January 15-19, 2024. Use the following information:

Progress this week:
- Deployed database migration to production (reduced query latency by 23%)
- Completed code review process improvements (now 2-hour SLA)
- Fixed 8 critical bugs in the API gateway
- Onboarded 2 new engineers to the team

Plans for next week:
- Begin work on caching layer optimization
- Schedule architecture review with leadership
- Complete documentation for new deployment pipeline
- Investigate performance issues in the message queue

Problems:
- One engineer out on medical leave (team at 80% capacity)
- Dependency upgrade blocked by incompatible third-party library
- Staging environment has been unstable (3 outages this week)

Output the 3P update to a file named 'platform-infrastructure-3p.md' using the exact format specified in the guidelines. The file must start with an emoji, include the team name and date range, and have exactly three sections (Progress, Plans, Problems) with 1-3 sentences each.
